tests.name: Four native button selections preserve semantic state, image, scene, destination and availability
Coming-soon entry and all unavailable destination shortcuts are captured without closing More
Keyboard arrows wrap and Home/End select exact focused sport; irrelevant keys remain untouched
All valid session selections restore and corrupt values safely default to NFL
Blocked session storage preserves all four fully functional selections

interactionSourceContracts.qualification: Event-contract regression on the actual interaction source in a minimal DOM harness; native rendering, pointer interception and production routing require the separate browser audit.

reflectionVisibility.qualification: Bounded naturally elapsed visible cap-reflection phases; ordinary unpaused native browser CTA-clipped PNG paint requests reduce full-screen PNG encoding latency. The declared clip is an actual screenshot region, never a modified source image. A phase with actual nonzero opacity is saved for each cap; full-phone originals and full natural-motion frames are separately preserved.

motion.qualification: Read-only computed values and actual animation objects sampled during natural elapsed time. Reduced motion uses a native browser media preference; no clock seeking, synthetic lifecycle event, CSS or DOM modifications.

researchFontReadiness.qualification: Additive native NFL entry and return with actual visible font-family, registered FontFace readiness and exact served woff2 bytes. Resource cancellations elsewhere remain recorded as resource events, not document-navigation events.

home.qualification: Actual native inputs, reloads and hit testing; no substituted data, manipulated DOM/CSS, sought animation phases or altered clock.

protectedRoutes.qualification: Protected-flow smoke uses real native routes and source identity; exhaustive statistics audits remain separately source-bound and are not replaced by these controls checks.
